There are no signs of obfuscated code, suspicious network operations, or unauthorized file modifications.

The package installs desktop entries, icons, documentation, and license files—standard for a GUI application. No dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl|bash`, `base64` decoding) are present, and no data exfiltration or remote execution mechanisms are included.

While the `source` URL uses HTTPS and points to a tagged release, it is not a mutable reference (like a branch), and the use of `--frozen` and `--locked` flags enhances reproducibility. All environment variables set (`RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN`, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`) are used to control the build environment safely. No post-install hooks or system modifications outside the package scope are performed.
</details>
